description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Sri Lanka Sri Lanka 2026 public, bank, mercantile and full-moon Poya holiday calendar, plus dated temporary government-office closures result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this is a combined official holiday-class calendar, not a universal private-employer closure rule. Public, bank and mercantile classifications remain in each event kind; the March 18, March 25 and April 1 fuel-conservation entries apply to government offices only and the schedule was cancelled effective April 8. Essential services, schools, private employers, sector agreements, local arrangements and later unlisted notices are not inferred. The additional day after the National Vesak Festival is not invented beyond the published May 2 calendar entry.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Sri Lanka: Poya holiday. | Sri Lanka: Temporary government-office Wednesday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-08-27"} | {"date":"2026-03-25"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/sri-lanka-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/sri-lanka-public-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Sri Lanka's pinned 2026 combined public/bank/mercantile holiday coverage over a Saturday-Sunday weekend.

name: check_lk_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Sri Lanka 2026 public, bank, mercantile and full-moon Poya holiday calendar, plus dated temporary government-office closures

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: published_official_dates_only; no next-day or employer-lieu inference; later Gazette or official circular overrides

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Sri Lanka Working Day
